Paul invokes the altar to ground the right of gospel ministers to material support (1 Cor 9:13). In Hebrews and Revelation the term extends to a heavenly altar of incense and a cosmic altar beneath which martyrs' souls cry out, showing how the physical structure becomes a symbol of perpetual communion between God and his people."
